tagline: Try it on. Know if it’s worth owning.
pitch: WorthWearing combines Perfect Corp’s virtual try-on technology with wardrobe intelligence to determine whether a new garment complements what you already own—or is likely to become your next return.
close_line: We don’t help shoppers buy more. We help them keep what they buy.
